assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
currently experiencing intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations
these symptoms raise concern for an underlying arrhythmia
the telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during symptomatic events
the telemetry is intended to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources
the telemetry is intended to evaluate cardioembolic sources contributing to the patient's transient cerebral ischemic symptoms
the service directly addresses the documented concern for an underlying arrhythmia
the service is in the context of the patient's transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
